experiment: R5.6 precision cleanup + burst-constrained audio completion
frozen_components: R5.5 burst-state detector level-1 + rule A level-2 (detector55)
C1 reconstruction (pre 15 ms / post 150 ms, attack 10 ms / release 60 ms)
audio refinement +/-40 ms on R4 comb
clean music alignment + final gain convention (0.5*ref + 0.5*interaction)

e1_precision_cleanup.description: candidate post-filter ONLY; changes which R5.5 candidates open windows
e1_precision_cleanup.no_transient: candidate stays in list, never opens a window (E0 convention)
e1_precision_cleanup.weak: open window only with extra support: (a) visual: prom_frac >= {weak_prom_frac} OR >= {weak_chan_n} channels above {weak_chan_floor} of p99.5 OR (in burst within {weak_burst_edge_ms} ms of a burst edge AND within {weak_near_sp_ms} ms of a strong/present candidate); (b) audio-rescue: comb peak >= {rescue_comb_peak} AND peak_over_noise >= {rescue_comb_ratio} (visually-silent true contacts)
e1_precision_cleanup.echo_ratio_suppression: REJECTED by Phase-1 audit: echo FPs are not separable from true adjacent contacts by visual peak ratio (median 1.09 vs 0.75-0.84; every useful threshold kills more true 90-120 ms doubles than echoes). Refinement confidence already covers 87/99 echo FPs via weak/no_transient.

e2_audio_completion.description: adds audio-only candidates ONLY inside E0-frozen active bursts, for visually-silent contacts with strong audio evidence
e2_audio_completion.source: frozen R4 comb envelope local peaks
e2_audio_completion.strong_tier: peak >= {min_peak} AND > {min_ratio}x local median of +/-0.25 s (excl. +/-60 ms), min distance {min_dist_s} s - mirrors the frozen 'strong' refinement level
e2_audio_completion.taiko_guard: music-removed residual support required: mid+hi1+hi2 >= {resid_sum_min} AND hi1 >= {hi1_min}; bass-only (taiko-like) onsets fail hi1
e2_audio_completion.dedup: >= {d_e1_min_ms} ms from every E1 window, >= {d_e2_min_ms} ms between added events
e2_audio_completion.hand_motion: recorded as bonus evidence only, never required

dev_evidence.window_convention: candidates = R5.5 visual candidate list (incl. no_transient); windows = gates actually opened
dev_evidence.completion_quality: 20 added events on devA/B/C: 18 match oracle within 80 ms; 0 bass-dominated; 5 coincide with music onsets but are residual-supported on-beat contacts (2 recovered strong oracle)

decision: E2 kept: strong recall does not drop on any window (devC +0.095), strong gate coverage rises on all three windows (+6.7/+4.2/+5.9 pt), false windows / music leakage drop on all three, UWR rises on all three, final-mix RMS improves on all three. E1 alone trades gate coverage down; E2's completion buys it back.
freeze_note: No parameter may be changed after this point based on holdout-D results. Holdout-D oracle annotation (video-first) must complete before the frozen pipeline runs on it.
